summary:
The selected signed Arch Skopeo1.21.0-1 acquisition was staged without a host install or binary execution. Its signed BUILDINFO PKGBUILD hash aa42babb04fbb43b2c4b9a0a10d222b6bf809c44a1467de32ba7e3891197145f matches official packaging commit04e5bf5aa073eb0c8fb7c40745541ff13d672fa8 (https://gitlab.archlinux.org/archlinux/packaging/packages/skopeo/-/blob/04e5bf5aa073eb0c8fb7c40745541ff13d672fa8/PKGBUILD), selecting upstream8bd9c541. Static binary build metadata agrees with that source and its CGO dependencies; Makefile edits explain modified=true, which is not reproducible-build verification. Source correspondence, signature acquisition, ELF metadata and successful execution are separate assertions. The public acquisition disposition https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6399023703 records a first armored-keyring parser refusal and a separately selected same-package/same-trusted-key verification after deterministic dearmor. No new key, trust update, replacement download or retroactive success was inferred.

Skopeo storage export avoids the libpod persistent-pause route, but it still initializes/locks shared storage metadata and can use mapping/overlay helpers. Its actual CGO namespace bootstrap hardcodes /tmp/containers.XXXXXX, ignoring TMPDIR: mkstemp creates an empty target for a transient read-only self-executable bind mount, followed by detach/unlink. The alternative executable clone is a sealed memfd, not a26MiB file written to/tmp. Crash cleanup needs causal ownership of that exact original pathname/inode or an established private mount; a prefix glob or unrelated before/after difference is insufficient. setresuid/setresgid and re-execution mean an initial parent-death signal is not a substitute for original enforcing cgroup/namespace/helper settlement.

There is no Skopeo unshare command or literal-path override. A pre-existing full-map wrapper could avoid internal re-exec only after actual required userns capabilities, both complete UID/GID maps, truthful original rootless identity, private mount propagation/tmp and hard cgroup containment are proved. Helpers must obtain mappings from the proper original parent; a single-ID namespace, early NoNewPrivileges, guessed generic wrapper or fabricated configured marker is not an equivalent. This is a conditional source-supported route, not an installed Home capability or selected profile.

Before operational export bind the exact signed executor/native/helper closure, external policy/configuration, existing store/options/maps and zero-retry/single-copy argv. Account full source-layer materialization, OCI staging, final archive, temporary files and memory together with actual backing/interference. An immutable OCI archive loaded by exact image ID preserves the intended seed semantics; live additional stores or rootfs import do not supply that contract. Keep original first failure and independently observed retirement. Native configuration metadata and current absence may be useful while a missed original-time settlement remains Unknown; no historical outcome is rewritten. At capture, operational copy remains unselected pending its own complete finite executor and failure cleanup, separately from the fresh no-image engine-initialization prefix.

Subsequent exact-source review separates version proximity from operational safety. Skopeo1.24.1 upstream77f3d92 vendors storage1.64.1 while installed-Podman source464c15f vendors1.64.2; their selected store.go bytes are identical. This narrows that implementation compatibility question, not the complete dependency/ABI or storage-library closure. Official Arch1.24.1-1 packaging b8380480 selects that upstream; separately verified signed package and inert ELF metadata are acquisition facts, not Home loader/symbol compatibility or a selected executor switch. The old1.21 source and first failures remain distinct.

GetStore takes graph-root locks and loads writable primary stores even for an image-reading command. Bind selected immutable image/config/layer inputs separately from explicitly admitted lock/cache effects; neither byte-identical mutable counters after copy nor unrestricted metadata changes express that contract. The overlay Diff path conditionally invokes naive driver Get/mount and configured helpers or composefs handling. No source claim here establishes a primary-store read-only switch, a supported consistent offline snapshot, or mount-free export for an uninspected actual layer population.

GetBlob copies a complete uncompressed layer stream to a temporary file and attempts early unlink while retaining its open FD. OCI archive output separately stages a complete OCI layout before writing the final tar. The selected big-file temporary directory affects both populations. A visible directory size/count can therefore miss live retained storage, and raw declared compressed-layer sizes do not bound all uncompressed, staging and final-archive use. Actual FD identity/size/allocated-block samples are useful bounded diagnostics; raced non-atomic samples do not establish an enforced aggregate peak. Close source population, per-file and aggregate limits, actual backing/interference and all owned helper/mount/namespace retirement before operational selection.

Persist already collected bounded streams, backing observations and known child state on first failure under the separate original cleanup allowance. A final reaper must obey its selected shorter cleanup endpoint rather than borrowing the whole parent envelope reserved for later collectors and independent retirement. Preserve the first deadline or collection failure; later evidence does not renew its clock or authorize an automatic copy retry. At this capture the complete export controller and actual Home1.24.1 native closure remain unaccepted; source controls and the accepted private no-image initialization do not substitute for them.
title: Offline image export closes namespace, temporary storage and original retirement
